posts.title: my captain's unbinding postmortem
posts.description: If you follow me anywhere, you are probably already aware of this, but I participated in TYVNJ2 ! I created the visual novel my captain's unbinding, which is about a yaoi shipper hallucinating (?) a member of her ship appearing in her room after a twist reveals that he's actually a woman. posts.title: Unknown Places Dev Post Mortem
posts.description: Hey there, long time no blog post. I hope you have been well. Recently, I released a new game called Unknown Places , an experiment in what I could do with my own event and dialogue system in Godot after improving my skills. posts.title: Hourly Comic Day 2026
posts.description: Hourly Comic Day was on February 8 this year and I did it! I was more successful than in previous years, mostly by keeping it very simple. I did everything in just ballpoint pen in my sketchbook and basically didn't redraw anything. I thought it would be best to collect them in a blog post. Here you go!
